title: Crash Bandicoot Recompiled
description:
An unofficial Crash Bandicoot (PlayStation) recompilation launcher built on RecompOne, with native 16:9 widescreen and mod support. The game is recompiled locally on first launch.

Requires your own USA disc dump (SCUS-94900). Import the matching .bin into PortForge's ROM library before installing; the installer creates its single-track .cue automatically. No game data is downloaded.

Windows 10/11 x64: open the launcher and choose Start Game. Linux x64: Play prepares and starts the game directly; OpenGL 4.3 or newer is required. OpenAL Soft and the .NET runtime are bundled. Keep the installed disc folder: the dump is required every time you play.

Project and support: https://github.com/Matteo842/CrashBandicoot-Launcher

This is a fan project, not affiliated with Sony, Activision, or Naughty Dog. Crash Bandicoot belongs to its respective rights holders.
